The authors note that while BA has been treated as a stable trait-like construct, it likely fluctuates across time and contexts, and they propose developing a state measure of BA. The section concludes by indicating that multiple studies will be reported to adapt and validate this new state measure of body appreciation.

7._section_summary: Study 2 describes a validation study of the SBAS-2 (State Body Appreciation Scale-2) designed to detect momentary changes in body appreciation. This methodology was based on previous research showing that perceived acceptance from important others is a strong predictor of body appreciation.
